name: BETAMETHASONE DIPROPIONATE / BETAMETHASONE SODIUM PHOSPHATE INJECTABLE SUSPENSION 1 AMPOULE
description: The injectable suspension containing betamethasone dipropionate and betamethasone sodium phosphate is a type of corticosteroid that provides both rapid and sustained relief from inflammation. This combination is used to treat a wide variety of medical conditions. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
